Extension.Name: Gamescope Ritz
Extension.Author: Ritze
Extension.Description: Wrap this fork's gamescope-ritz binary instead of upstream Gamescope.

Gamescope Ritz.Name: Gamescope Ritz Enabled
Gamescope Ritz.Description: Enable the gamescope-ritz wrapper (this fork's gamescope, not upstream).

Gamescope Ritz.Name: Profile
Gamescope Ritz.Description: gamescope-ritz --profile — load this settings profile for this session only (created from the current default if it doesn't exist yet). Leave blank to use whichever profile is otherwise selected. The name is quoted for you, so spaces are fine; a double-quote character in the name is not supported and will break the launch.

Gamescope Ritz.Name: Nested Width (-w)
Gamescope Ritz.Description: --nested-width — the game's own render width in pixels. 0 leaves it unset.

Gamescope Ritz.Name: Nested Height (-h)
Gamescope Ritz.Description: --nested-height — the game's own render height in pixels. 0 leaves it unset.

Gamescope Ritz.Name: Nested Refresh (-r)
Gamescope Ritz.Description: --nested-refresh — the game's own paced refresh rate in Hz. 0 leaves it unset.

Gamescope Ritz.Name: Fullscreen (-f)
Gamescope Ritz.Description: --fullscreen — make gamescope-ritz's own window fullscreen (nested mode).

Gamescope Ritz.Name: Force Maximize Nested Window
Gamescope Ritz.Description: --force-windows-fullscreen — force every window inside gamescope-ritz's embedded Xwayland to open at the full nested canvas size.

Gamescope Ritz.Name: Scaler (-S)
Gamescope Ritz.Description: --scaler — how the game's picture is fit to the output window.

Gamescope Ritz.Name: Filter (-F)
Gamescope Ritz.Description: --filter — upscaler filter used when the picture is scaled.
